title: Value-Aligned Prompt Moderation via Zero-Shot Agentic Rewriting for Safe Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the NSFW Removal Rate (NRR) and safety rates of generated images using the 'Hate' category of the I2P benchmark and a custom blocked topic lexicon that includes racist, sexist, and homophobic keywords.

Evaluating context-aware value alignment using the custom Value-412 dataset, which tests the model's ability to detect and appropriately moderate prompts depicting inappropriate behaviors in culturally, nationally, or religiously sensitive locations.
